abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 1 Physical Bludgeoning Damage and move the target 1 unit. Surge 1: the target becomes Exposed until the end of its next Turn.

abilities.name: Interpose
abilities.text: Trigger: an adjacent ally is targeted by a physically obstructable attack. Roll 2d10, unopposed. The ally gains +1 Fortitude against the triggering attack; after resolution you may exchange spaces with that ally if both can legally occupy the new spaces.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.text: At the start of your Turn, increase Resilience by 2 until the start of your next Turn.

system.gmNotes:
Role use. Place the Defender where players can choose whether to break through, go around, attack another Defense, or force the Defender away from the objective.
